title.zh: 【加密基础设施公司 Zerohash 推出 AUTH，支持在关联账户间转移加密资产】
title.en: 【加密基础设施公司 Zerohash 推出 AUTH，支持在关联账户间转移加密资产】

current_state.zh: Crypto infrastructure firm Zerohash launched AUTH at Money20/20, letting users move crypto, stablecoins and tokenized securities between linked exchange accounts and self-custody wallets without copying addresses or picking a blockchain, with Coinbase, Robinhood and Gemini live, Kraken in testing and 600+ wallets supported.
